skills.description: 规范化 Obsidian Flavored Markdown 笔记——标题层级、双链注入、标签同步、引号统一、零宽空格还原等 18 项诊断与自动修复
skills.description_zh: Create, edit, and format Obsidian Flavored Markdown notes with proper wikilinks, embeds, callouts, and heading structure. Uses ### for main titles and sections. Auto-diagnose and fix common format issues like list spacing, missing paragraph spacing, heading levels, link syntax, and 名言 quoting. Proactively adds `###` section headings to body text exceeding 2-3 paragraphs without headings, and detects paragraphs running together without blank lines. Automatically converts title-like lines (emoji-based, short standalone text) to proper headings. When formatting 名言 (famous quotes), applies 一句一行 (one sentence per line) layout. Provides incremental edit strategy guidance for large text restructures. Use when working with .md files in Obsidian vaults, when user mentions wikilinks, callouts, frontmatter, or asks to format/check/optimize markdown notes. Also evaluates main heading content quality (fused from obsidian-title): rewrites poor titles — keyword-only, generic, repeating frontmatter title, or carrying clipping-noise prefixes like date numbers (8.1.20260815) / filler phrases (按年份整理好了) — by summarizing from body content, then syncs frontmatter three-way title fields (title, oldtitle, 标题); only rewrites when quality is poor, never rewrites good titles. For title-only changes use /obsidian-title. Also removes redundant horizontal rules (---) from body text (frontmatter boundaries kept), keeps inline tags and frontmatter tags in sync, and respects dinox/五彩-managed frontmatter fields (sync fields like feishu_url, noteId, 创建时间, oldtitle stay untouched to avoid sync-overwrite loops).
skills.name: Obsidian Markdown 中文规范版
